sources.title: Iris-3B · Speridlabs
sources.snippet: Iris-3B is a pixel-space generative model that can act as a general vision learner. Working in pixel space, it bypasses the lossy compression and the biased, texture-focused latents of a VAE.

sources.title: SperidLabs' Iris-3B Scales Pixel-Space Diffusion to 3B Params, Matches ...
sources.snippet: SperidLabs released Iris-3B, a 3B-parameter pixel-space text-to-image transformer trained from scratch through a 256→512→1024 curriculum that matches Qwen-Image on OneIG at 1024² without a VAE. The paper also converts FLUX.2 Klein base 4B to pixel space, then reports a negative result: on monocular depth and 4x DIV2K restoration a pixel-space generative prior offered no significant gain ...

sources.title: Speridlabs — Spatial AI lab
sources.snippet: Iris-3B A fully open 3B pixel-space text-to-image model — no VAE, every pixel generated — and a generative prior that acts as a general vision learner.

sources.title: [2610.09450] Iris-3B: Going Beyond the Latent with Pixel-Space ...
sources.snippet: We pretrain Iris-3B, a 3B-parameter pixel-space text-to-image transformer, from scratch through a 256 → 512 → 1024 curriculum, after first ablating the prediction target and representation alignment at 2562 to decide what to scale. We also convert a pretrained latent model, FLUX.2 Klein base 4B, to pixel space.
